intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A grateful patient has given Senna a pastry. She breaks it in half and holds both halves up to the light.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Out comes the magnifying lens. She questions a single currant until it has nothing left to say.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Butter. Currants. Something the baker is calling cinnamon.”

options.labelText: “What’s he calling cinnamon, then? I’ll wait for the full report.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Nutmeg. A big enough dose makes you very ill. This is a festive dose.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She hands you the bigger half. You can tell she checked that too.

options.labelText: “Looks perfect. I’m eating mine while you finish.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You eat your half before she can stop you.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “You ate it before the verdict. Now you’ll never know the verdict.”

options.labelText: “That’s cinnamon. I can smell it from here.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “It’s nutmeg. The cinnamon is a rumor.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She hands you the smaller half.
